label: mnemonics
note: dirty, weird, memorable. the weirder it is the harder it sticks. built during study sessions, saved here so they survive compaction. mish's brain runs on association — give it something it can't forget.

rules.dirty_over_clean: a mnemonic involving pussy, cock, or taro will stick longer than a textbook one. use the vocabulary mish actually thinks in.
rules.personal_over_generic: mnemonics referencing mish's life (sushihaya, spam bowls, prisogoto, catburry) stick better than generic ones.
rules.short_over_long: one sentence max. if it needs explaining it's too complex.
rules.test_it: if mish can recall the mnemonic 3 sessions later without prompting, it worked. log it as proven.
